script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

EXT. CORNFIELD - MORNING

A golden sun rises over a quaint, rolling cornfield. CRickets sing in the grass. Far off, a rooster crows.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
(whispering)
In the heart of the Midwest, a small town breathes life into its people.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

Customers sipping coffee and reading the local paper. Waitress SARAH, in her late twenties, sets down a steaming mug in front of JASON, an intriguing stranger.

SARAH
(smiling)
Your coffee's ready, sir.

JASON
(looking up)
Thank you, Sarah.

Jason's eyes meet Sarah's. She blushes, looking away.

INT. LOCAL MARKET - AFTERNOON

Jason browses the colorful stalls, taking in the sights, sounds, and smells. Sarah, pushing a shopping cart, bumps into him.

SARAH
(apologizing)
I'm so sorry, I wasn't looking where I was going.

JASON
(smiling)
No harm done.

They exchange a warm smile.

EXT. TOWN PARK - EVENING

Jason and Sarah sit on a bench, gazing at the picturesque sunset. They share stories about their lives and dreams.

SARAH
You know, I've always wanted to travel the world.

JASON
(nods)
I've always wanted to write a book.

They laugh and lean closer, sharing a tender moment.

INT. SARAH'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Sarah, sitting on her porch, watches the stars twinkle in the clear night sky. She looks down at a picture of her deceased father, smiling.

SARAH (V.O.)
(whispering)
Dad always said, "Life's too short for regret." I think it's time I follow my dreams.

EXT. TOWN SQUARE - DAY

Jason, dressed in a suit, approaches Sarah, who is wearing a beautiful red dress. They share a romantic kiss in the middle of the empty square.

SARAH
(tearfully)
I can't believe I'm doing this.

JASON
(smiling)
Believe it, Sarah. We're going to make beautiful memories together.

They leave the square, hand in hand, ready to start a new life.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

Sarah serves coffee to customers, her heart full of joy. Jason enters, and they share a lingering gaze.

SARAH
(smiling)
Good morning, Jason.

JASON
(smiling back)
Good morning, Sarah.

FADE OUT.

---

This screenplay is an original, modern romance set in a small Midwestern town. It adheres to the given genre, theme, and constraints while maintaining a realistic pace and proper screenplay format.
